mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.board.updateBoard */ SET BOARD_ID = #{boardId} , PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} , BOARD_TITLE = #{boardTitle} WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM BOARD /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.board.deleteBoard */ WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.board.selectBoard */ BOARD_ID as boardId, PROJECT_ID as projectId, BOARD_TITLE as boardTitle FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.board.selectListBoard */ BOARD_ID as boardId, PROJECT_ID as projectId, BOARD_TITLE as boardTitle FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT * FROM BOARD WHERE 1=1
) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.board.selectListCountBoard */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM BOARD WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.board.selectBoardsByProject */ BOARD_ID as boardId, PROJECT_ID as projectId, BOARD_TITLE as boardTitle FROM BOARD WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ORDER BY BOARD_ID ASC
